citations.claim: Pole exceeded upright limit at first violating step; cart position shows drift
Mechanical energy grew due to instability
One step before violation pole already near limit with high cart speed

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.01349 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical; controller stabilizes and no pole_upright violation occurs.

explanation: Large outer dt (~0.0193) with seeded sensor noise destabilizes the fixed state-feedback controller: starting from upright with initial cart velocity, noisy angle/rate measurements cause incorrect forces, pole angle grows to 0.72 rad by step 18 and exceeds 0.8 rad at step 19. Removing noise alone restores stability, confirming noise-induced loss of control at coarse dt.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track while the pole leans increasingly to the right through steps 16 to 18. At step 19 the pole tip turns red, marking the pole exceeding the upright limit without any abrupt cart excursion.
